generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Solar power station (太阳能电站). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Create a sunlit utility-scale solar farm from a low aisle viewpoint, using one row of photovoltaic modules as a strong diagonal into the distance. At the near end, show the inverter cabinet, compact battery unit and combiner box as separate grounded enclosures. On a clean service cart in the foreground, isolate the clamp meter, insulated gloves, cable connector, cleaning brush and infrared camera. Place a plain temporary safety barrier around the open service zone without any writing. One technician may inspect the outside of a closed cabinet, hands away from targets. Preserve realistic cable routing, panel reflections and midday shadows. No rooftop setting, broken panels, exposed live conductors, readable warning signs, glowing energy effects, duplicate tools or endless clutter.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: photovoltaic module array, solar string inverter cabinet, battery energy-storage unit, solar combiner box, solar clamp meter, insulated electrical work gloves, photovoltaic cable connector, solar-panel cleaning brush, temporary electrical safety barrier, infrared inspection camera.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
